title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, up to five pictures
description: Combine up to five pictures: each is scaled to 1 megapixel and given to the model as a reference, in order, and the prompt says what to do with them (image 1, image 2, and so on). Bypass the Reference images you do not need. The settings of the DA all-in-one workflow: seed 776, 6 steps.
